resources.string: Show search. This build lets you search shows by keyword, which contacts public search APIs (Apple Podcasts, fyyd.de, gpodder.net). Those requests carry no credentials and no user identifiers either.

Offline speech-to-text. This build bundles offline speech recognition (the open-source whisper.cpp plus a bundled model). Turning an episode\'s audio into text happens entirely on your device — the audio is never uploaded, never leaves the device, and never passes through any server. You can turn this off in Settings.

Ilumina cada palabra mientras se pronuncia. El reconocimiento en el dispositivo debe calcular los tiempos por palabra, lo que añade cerca del 70 % al tiempo de transcripción (unos 11 minutos para un episodio de una hora).
